name: How much more does it cost to buy property confidentially?

mainEntity.name: How much more does it cost to buy property confidentially?

acceptedAnswer.text: While there isn't a direct 'confidentiality fee,' the costs associated with a confidential property purchase can sometimes be different compared to a standard transaction. For instance, you might incur legal fees for drafting robust non-disclosure agreements or establishing an LLC for anonymous ownership. Some off-market properties might also be priced differently due to their exclusive availability, potentially requiring skilled negotiation to secure a fair deal. Your real estate professional can help assess these potential cost differences as part of the overall purchase strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: There's no direct confidentiality fee, but related costs might include legal fees for NDAs or anonymous ownership structures. Off-market pricing can also vary.
